claims.claim: You can register as a sole trader online.
claims.quote: Use this tool to register for Self Assessment as a sole trader with HM Revenue and Customs ( HMRC ).
claims.note: The page offers an online tool with a Start now button to register.

claims.claim: A National Insurance number is needed to register.
claims.quote: You’ll need a National Insurance number to register for Self Assessment.
claims.note: The source states the National Insurance number is needed.

claims.claim: A Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) is issued after registration.
claims.quote: If you’re waiting for a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR), you can check when you can expect a reply from HMRC .
claims.note: Under 'If you’ve already registered', the source implies a UTR follows registration.
